summary: Hepion Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 17.5 million shares of common stock at $0.04 per share, raising $700,000 in gross proceeds. The offering closed on April 21, 2026, and was conducted under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b) exemption. The filing includes customary representations, warranties, and indemnification. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation event.
